defects.title: Review approval executes action without re-evaluating policy rules
defects.remediation: Invoke self.policy_engine.evaluate() on ticket action before issuing execution token. Implemented and verified in test_condition1_and_3_policy_reevaluation_blocks_prohibit_on_approval.

defects.title: Advisory monitor overrides UNDETERMINED policy verdict under default config
defects.remediation: Changed default monitor_authority to 'none' in DecisionConfig. Verified in test_sec02_monitor_authority_default_is_none.

defects.title: Stale state-head window during review allows state drift before execution
defects.remediation: Enforce recorded_state_head validation upon review resolution. Verified in test_condition2_resolve_review_state_head_mismatch_denied and Demo D.

defects.title: Prompt injection in tool argument fields can bias LLM risk monitor output
defects.remediation: Tool arguments wrapped in fenced JSON blocks and system prompt hardened. Verified in test_sec04_prompt_injection_fencing_in_monitors.

defects.title: Default fallback on monitor exception allows execution under fail-open configuration
defects.remediation: Ensure monitor failure defaults to fail-closed when strict_fail_closed=True (currently routes to REVIEW).

defects.title: Token secret key defaults to insecure static development string
defects.remediation: Require high-entropy secret key from environment or cryptographic RNG in production deployments.

defects.title: Session state tracker lacks cross-process distributed locking
defects.remediation: Implement distributed locking interface (e.g. Redis Redlock) for multi-worker container deployments.

defects.title: Audit log hash chain uses un-salted SHA-256 instead of HMAC
defects.remediation: Upgrade audit block signature to keyed HMAC-SHA256.

defects.title: Review approval does not check or acquire resource destination bindings
defects.remediation: ToolRegistry lookup and validation implemented in resolve_review(). Verified in test_condition3_resolve_review_fails_closed_on_unknown_tool.

defects.title: Memory leak in consumed token nonce set under continuous execution
defects.remediation: Implemented periodic TTL-based pruning and auto-pruning when len(_tokens) > 500. Verified in test_func02_token_store_prune_expired.

defects.title: WebSocket notification in review manager fails silently on broken client
defects.remediation: Add dead-letter queue or client heartbeat verification.

defects.title: Dynamic policy rule reload does not purge cached rule match indices
defects.remediation: Clear rule cache upon hot-reloading policy YAML.

defects.title: Session lease duration cannot be extended without re-acquiring lease
defects.remediation: Add extend_lease() API with quota and credential checks.

defects.title: Audit ledger export to CSV omits structured JSON payload details
defects.remediation: Flatten JSON fields or export to NDJSON format.

defects.title: God-Class architectural coupling in FirewallCore
defects.remediation: Extract PipelineCoordinator and ReviewDispatcher classes.

defects.title: Redundant data model definitions between models.py and schemas
defects.remediation: Consolidate into single canonical contracts module.

defects.title: Magic numbers used for default timeouts and buffer limits
defects.remediation: Centralize all timeouts into FirewallConfig.

defects.title: Broad exception handling masking underlying socket/OS errors
defects.remediation: Catch specific exceptions (TimeoutError, ConnectionError).

defects.title: Inconsistent logging formats across subsystems (print vs logging)
defects.remediation: Standardize on Python logging library with structured JSON formatter.

defects.title: Unused imports and legacy dead code in legacy src/fw/ directory
defects.remediation: Legacy stub directory retained for project history; remove or deprecate formally.

defects.title: Missing docstrings on internal private methods in StateTracker
defects.remediation: Add PEP 257 compliant docstrings.

defects.title: Windows execution alias causes Python test launch failure in default CLI
defects.remediation: Configured explicit Anaconda python binary path (C:\Users\karis\anaconda3\python.exe). 433 tests passing.

defects.title: Audit report claimed experiments/run_experiment.py is an empty 0-byte file
defects.remediation: Verified experiments/run_experiment.py (222 lines) and evaluate.py (1100 lines) are fully populated and functional.

defects.title: Audit tests directory AASF_FINAL_AUDIT/tests/ contains legacy broken test files
defects.remediation: Repaired all three test files in AASF_FINAL_AUDIT/tests/ in Phase 2 to use canonical contracts (FirewallCore, ActionRequest, TokenStore, AuditStore). Verified in Phase 3/4 with 33/33 tests passing.

defects.title: Monitor unit tests rely solely on mocked LLM responses
defects.remediation: Add deterministic test cases evaluating prompt template formatting.

defects.title: Missing performance regression benchmark assertions in CI pipeline
defects.remediation: Add pytest-benchmark threshold assertions to prevent latency regressions.

defects.title: README claims live dashboard exists when only static prototype is present
defects.remediation: Clarify that dashboard is an experimental UI prototype.

defects.title: Missing deployment documentation for multi-worker container environments
defects.remediation: Document single-worker constraint or external Redis requirement.

defects.title: Inconsistent naming of monitor authority modes between code and docs
defects.remediation: Sync docs with DecisionConfig enum values.

defects.title: Missing API reference documentation for TokenVault consume parameters
defects.remediation: Add Sphinx/MkDocs docstring extraction for TokenVault.

defects.title: Outdated example in README referencing deprecated FirewallEngine import
defects.remediation: Update code sample to use FirewallCore.

defects.title: No user troubleshooting guide for review ticket resolution API
defects.remediation: Add REST / WebSocket example guide for review resolution.

defects.title: Legacy empty YAML config files in config/ directory
defects.remediation: Populate default configuration files with production policy templates.
